rust_summary: a held world (`native_world_hold`): the terrain kept drawn as it stands while the world changes under it, and every change shown on one frame when let go.
doc_summary:
a held world through `native_world_hold`: once a frame a client mod can hold the terrain's picture, all of it or
only inside circles; sections on screen that change are meshed and uploaded but wait beside the ones drawn, and
letting go shows them all on one frame ([Holding the world's picture](#holding-the-worlds-picture)). Bundles need
`"hooks": @API:world_hold@`.
